document.title: Individual psychotherapy note, encounter HG-E111 (added visit during group)

quotes: Rowan participated throughout the individual contact and reported that the immediate intensity of anxiety eased enough to discuss a next step.

observations.statement: Rowan became anxious during group and needed individual grounding and a review of coping strategies.
observations.quote: This visit was added because Rowan became anxious during group and needed individual grounding and review of coping strategies.

observations.statement: Rowan felt overwhelmed when other group members talked about work demands and worried about keeping up after returning to work.
observations.quote: The patient described feeling overwhelmed when other members discussed workplace demands and worried that returning to work would expose difficulties keeping up.

observations.statement: Rowan named muscle tension, rapid breathing and an urge to leave as early signs of activation.
observations.quote: Rowan was able to identify muscle tension, rapid breathing, and an urge to leave as early signs of activation.

observations.statement: Rowan took part for the whole contact and said the anxiety eased enough to discuss a next step.
observations.quote: Rowan participated throughout the individual contact and reported that the immediate intensity of anxiety eased enough to discuss a next step.

observations.statement: Rowan denied current suicidal thoughts and stayed future oriented.
observations.quote: Rowan denied current suicidal thoughts and remained future oriented in discussing the next appointment.

observations.statement: The clinician found no acute safety concern during this contact.
observations.quote: No acute safety concern was identified during this contact.

observations.statement: Ongoing avoidance and disrupted sleep continue to get in the way of returning to a usual work routine.
observations.quote: Persistent avoidance and disrupted sleep continue to interfere with resuming a usual work routine.
